checks: Flows opens beside the existing compass and layer slider without writing data, moving the camera or discarding an unsaved main note
Search selects existing concepts and suborbitals; repeated occurrences have independent step IDs and stay in an unsaved draft
A saved flow retains conditional and terminal edges in JSON and history while preserving canonical notes, coordinates, adjacency and heat counts
Connection field edits survive selecting another edge, and Save flow applies pending branch edits without requiring an extra update click
The independent native 3D arrow overlay crosses layers, dims unrelated concepts, exposes children of multiple parents and remains non-pickable
Study renders canonical notes, headings, emphasis, recall prompts and concept links; multiple outgoing branches require an explicit learner choice
Allowed and Blocked branches highlight their own paths; terminal choices and Previous retrace the actual visit trail without saving revisions
Concept links highlight shared references; leaving a flow restores the exact camera, filters and dirty inspector and removes all temporary actors
Edit concept note updates one canonical record, refreshes every occurrence and restores the updated standard editor on leaving the flow
Opening a flow from a focused orbit restores contextual visibility without moving the camera and restores the original orbit focus on return
Flows can be entered from Blocks and return to the original representation with connection controls and camera restored
Unsaved suborbital note drafts remain intact when the study panel opens and closes
Failed saves preserve flow drafts and authoritative JSON/history; Cancel keeps the flow open with its unsaved changes
Focus respects hidden filters, Show flow layers reveals the process, arrows survive rotation and the study controls fit the minimum window
Deleting a referenced suborbital warns about affected flows, retains a marked missing step and supports relinking it to another existing concept
Saved-state History lists flows, displays their steps and original referenced notes in its independent scene and leaves the active document unchanged
